This product may work well for some, but it just wasn't right for my skin. Every time I used the Clinique exfoliator—even just once a week—I would break out really badly, sometimes with two or more new pimples each time. I've spoken with others who've used it, and many said it didn't cause purging or breakouts for them, so it clearly varies from person to person. Unfortunately, for me, it caused more harm than good. If you have acne-prone or sensitive skin, I'd definitely recommend patch-testing before committing.

i'm so glad i've come back to my clinique 3-step skincare routine after about 15-20 years. i have strong memories of fighting my teenage acne with this same exact formula. it helped me fight breakouts then & still does now in my 30s too!

avis.titre: The First Product I Use Post Face Wash
avis.texte: I've used this product now for the better part of 20 years. I've tried different formulas for different skin types, but I find that even with my (mostly-dry) combination SENSITIVE skin. All of the other toners I've purchased don't seem to do more than leave residue on my skin that later brings on acne. I love this toner and won't be searching for another one.

I've been using this product for maybe 8 years now and I *have* to use it after cleansing. I put a little on a cotton pad and swipe it across my face and neck and it always picks up extra dust/grime that the cleanser doesn't. I ran out a few weeks ago and finally restocked because of the sale and I'm excited to get back to using this!

My first use of this Lotion 3 was as a sample product with my order. Just like the Clarifying Lotion 2 I immediately loved it! I could not see the big difference between the Lotion 2 and 3 but both do not have a greasy feel which was what I was looking for. No slimy residue or glossy finish on the face. I call this my gentle liquid toner. Simply basic and no uneasy tingling sensation even with fresh blemishes present. I use this alternately with my Lotion 2 so I will never run out.

For those who said this product negatively affected their skin, they most likely didnt use the right one for their skin type. There are 4 different versions of this clarifying lotion from very dry to super oily so its important to really assess your skin type/get the right one to see the best results. with that being said, I love this product!!!!! In the morning i wash my face with a gentle cleanser, sweep this across my face with a cotton ball, then let dry and follow it with an acne lotion (i use the mattifying one from cetaphil). My skin looks so bright and smooth all day long! It also doesnt affect any of my skin makeup if theres a day when I want to look more done up, however, lately all ive had to do is sweep some blush on my cheeks, mascara, and a lipstick and im ready for the day! At night I do the same but instead follow with my night time serums. I think this helps everything absorb much better than it did before. I havent had any of my occasional breakouts that i usually get like clockwork since adding this into my routine and im even getting compliments. My skin has never been this clear and smooth, especially this effortlessly!
